description: Burn subtitles into ANY video and get the .srt too; nothing is cut or re-rendered. Set textStyle only when the user describes a look (default: white sentence case, thin outline, bottom). Timed by the spoken words (up to 5 words a line); auto:'sentences' times per sentence. Only when asked, textStyle 'highlight' (or a highlightColor) lights the word being said, timed word by word. Or pass cues to burn your own lines exactly, untranscribed (reel-style phrases, *stage directions*). burn:false returns only the .srt. Takes a video file or URL, a Vimeo-style page, or a TikTok / Reel / X post link (not YouTube: YouTube does not let us download videos, so upload the file). No speech is refused and refunded. Runs in the background and lands in the Library.

auto.description: words (default) or sentences: timing unit for transcribed subtitles

cues.description: your own lines in seconds, no overlap, max 90 chars, no emoji

text.description: subtitle line text, max 90 characters, no emoji

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

font.description: sans|serif|elegant|condensed|hand or any Google Fonts family

highlightColor.description: word-timed subtitles only: the word being said is lit in this colour (preset highlight sets it)

textStyle.description: the look: words, a preset or fields; omit for the default

video.description: the video to subtitle; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

wordsPerCue.description: words per subtitle line when timed by words

name: add_subtitles
title: Add subtitles to a video
